capabilities.name: Extract structured data from text (API)
capabilities.description: Send text to a data-extraction API and get emails, dates, amounts and links back as JSON. Procured per call from the provider's OpenAPI.

capabilities.name: Order food for delivery
capabilities.description: Find a restaurant, build a cart from your order and place it after you approve the quote. The merchant is paid by you at its checkout.
providers: Food Delivery (MOCK — not connected to Swiggy)

capabilities.name: Historical market candles
capabilities.description: Closed OHLCV bars used by Strategy Lab backtests.

capabilities.name: Buy a digital product
capabilities.description: Find and buy a digital product (gift code, e-book, software licence) from a store, with a quote and your approval before anything is ordered.

capabilities.name: Token risk signal
capabilities.description: 0–100 risk score for an ERC-20 contract (liquidity, holder concentration, contract flags).

capabilities.name: Token verdict
capabilities.description: Categorical verdict for an ERC-20 contract derived from risk indicators.

capabilities.name: Paper trade a GO strategy (simulation)
capabilities.description: Place a simulated paper order for a strategy whose evaluation is GO. Filled by the internal paper broker on synthetic data — no broker, no real order.

capabilities.name: Evaluate a trading strategy (simulation)
capabilities.description: Turn a strategy description into a validated spec and run a walk-forward backtest with fees and slippage on a labelled synthetic dataset; a deterministic risk policy returns GO, WAIT or REJECT with its reasons.

capabilities.name: Wallet balance check
capabilities.description: Native and token balance for a public wallet address.
